scope: the tissue samples were separated by laser capture microdissection in tumor and stromal components

the microdissected samples were dissolved in 20 μL of 0.1% RapiGest SF (Waters, Milford, MA, USA) and transferred into LoBind Eppendorf tubes (Eppendorf AG, Hamburg, Germany) and were digested with trypsin.
